name: com.hawkes.net
description: Multiplayer for Unity WebGL games on Hawkes Net (https://net.hawkesgen.com). HawkesNetLobby puts players in shared rooms by area (live and test rooms, shards when full, rejoining); HawkesNetAvatars draws everyone from a prefab; HawkesNet.Join gives a room with messages (once and in order, or newest-wins), poses, peers, the host and the shared clock. Peer to peer for small rooms, the relay for big ones, moved between them without reconnecting. Runs Hawkes Net's web SDK in the page; in the Editor a join reports that it needs a WebGL build.

samples.description: One script: a capsule you walk with WASD and everyone else in the room, through HawkesNetAvatars.
